text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It happened right after the awards ceremony concluded—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble, rumble, rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"No...! What's that sound!?"
"An earthquake...!? We have to evacuate—!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To prevent the commotion from growing any larger, I hurried away from the scene with Manhattan Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, having returned to the hotel—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crash, thump, bang—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flicker, flicker, flick—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rumble, rumble, rumble...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Inside the room, it's a non-stop parade of supernatural phenomena.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...My 'friend'...
...brought their friends along...
for a victory party...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "It seems the... Fantômes of this land... are quite... pleased as well..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With furniture occasionally flying across the room and the lights cutting out,
I can't even properly bask in the afterglow of victory like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: “Yet, perhaps it can't be helped. After all, today's victory is one that will be etched into the history of Umamusume racing.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was such a monumental feat that even the "unseen entities" were frolicking about—!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fans
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOO!!!! YES!!
A Japanese Umamusume has won... the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!

text_block_list.name: Japanese Fans
text_block_list.text:
That was incredible, Manhattan Cafe!!
Thank you for the dream!! And for the victory!!

text_block_list.name: Local Fans
text_block_list.text:
"What a magnificent run!!"
"That was a wonderful race, please come back and run again!"

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Just as much as my 'friends'...
I, too... am excited...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Surely... today is something I will never forget...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching Manhattan Cafe laugh as she said that,
the noise in the room gradually stopped bothering me.
choice_data_list: In that case, let's celebrate too!
In that case, shall we celebrate too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, the room's lights cut out completely,
and a chill draft of air blew against the back of my neck—

C
          o
                m  e   --

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though a chill ran down my spine for a moment—
the victory party with the unseen "somethings" continued until nearly midnight.
